name: v3.2.0
body:
## Archify v3.2.0

Create a conclusion-first one-page answer from Markdown, with cited sources, interactive diagrams and browser exports.

### Added

- **One-page answers (explainer) (#993).** Ask your agent to answer as a page and Archify builds a conclusion-first explainer from a Markdown draft. Each panel answers one question, using prose, tables, steps, checklists, charts, code and validated native diagrams.
  - **Authoring and delivery:** `finalize explainer` validates, delivers atomically and checks the page. Charts come from a Mermaid fence or a CSV/JSON file next to the draft. Repository excerpts are read from the pinned commit. `patch explainer` replaces one panel by ID.
  - **Reading:**
    - Steps sit beside the diagram they walk through, and you can step through them.
    - Text and diagram nodes highlight each other.
    - Clicking a node opens the full Viewer focused on it.
    - Citations and source-linked nodes open source cards.
    - Each panel or selected passage produces a follow-up question that targets that panel.
  - **Sharing:** the page ships in four styles (clean, editorial, product, Swiss) with light and dark themes, and exports a PNG, WebP or JPG long image or prints to PDF.
  - **Examples:** four live pages in `docs/cases/explainer/`.
  - **Credit:** the one-page document direction of #942 by @goatliamia shaped this work.
  - **Acknowledgment:** thanks to @QingYunA for the early one-page diagram-and-explanation proposal and demo prototype.

### Fixed

- **Explainer pages no longer carry local paths.** The draft embedded in a page names its source and data files relative to the page, so a shared page does not reveal the author's directories. `patch explainer` resolves them against the page again.

- **Explainer long images keep the page's style and theme.** A PNG, WebP or JPG export of a dark page, or of the editorial, product or Swiss style, came out in the light clean style, because the page is drawn inside an SVG where its `<html>` is not `:root`. The export now selects the page root by its own attribute.

- **Blank chart data is an error, not zero.** An empty CSV cell, a JSON `null` or a missing field in a charted column no longer becomes a zero bar. Finalize names the column and row instead.

- **Workflow migration semantic contracts (#497).** Layout planning no longer checks full-topology requirements against a temporary graph with routed edges removed. Migrated documents retain their authored contracts and must pass complete validation before publication.

- **Timeline 时区刻度（#926）。** 刻度按显示时区在各真实时刻的 UTC 偏移对齐，修复跨夏令时后日刻度漂移到 01:00／23:00、半小时跳变后小时刻度漂移的问题。回拨的重复时刻保持独立，跳过的小时或日期不生成虚构刻度；事件时间、标签精度、时间轴比例与断轴规则保持不变。

### Changed
- **Reader controls and node index.** Compact bottom index rows keep descriptions below titles; menu and roving keyboard navigation respect modifier keys.
- **Update notices.** Available updates include a release summary and an offer to help update. Network failures remain non-blocking.
- **Website and portability.** The bilingual homepage and gallery introduce one-page answers while retaining guides and source-backed cases. Browser discovery, Windows command paths, source-directory whitespace and temporary-worktree cleanup receive focused fixes.

### Distribution
- Download `archify.zip` below. Stable update notifications are published separately after the archive has been verified.
- The separately versioned DSH plugin is not republished with this release; maintainers must select a pinned source and complete its host/package acceptance in a separate follow-up.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify/compare/v3.1.0...v3.2.0

name: v3.1.0
body:
## Archify 3.1.0

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d6144aba-cb48-4692-a24d-b43bf7be62c2

*30 seconds of Archify 3.1: five new diagram types, Live motion, light and dark.*

Ten diagram types, with Live motion enabled by default: **ERD, Class/interface, Tree, Timeline and Waterfall** join Architecture, Workflow, Sequence, Dataflow and Lifecycle.

- Type-specific motion stays separate from authored topology; switch to Still when needed.
- Clearer cards, routing/label coordination, Sequence notes, Lifecycle layouts, and long-page reader navigation.
- Structured authoring diagnostics, bounded recovery, source verification and distinct input/artifact/browser delivery gates.
- Export, clipboard and Windows path portability fixes; a localized optional repository link inside the reader-opened Guide.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify/blob/v3.1.0/CHANGELOG.md#310--2026-10-14) · [Release scope and trial-use evidence](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify/blob/v3.1.0/docs/releases/3.1.0.md)

Download `archify.zip` below, or use the canonical Skill source. Existing installations update only when their owner chooses to upgrade.

Known limitations include initial-viewport control overlap in some long Sequence diagrams, shared visual corridors in some Dataflow diagrams, and awkward wrapping of long Class generic types. Automated validation does not replace perceptual review. Timeline/Waterfall values require evidence to be described as factual/measured; illustrative examples remain labelled.

The independently published DSH plugin remains 1.0.0 / bundled Archify 3.0.1; its synchronization is a separate follow-up. Expanded public examples, README previews and website entry points are tracked in #916, #917 and #918.

Source: `1c2b42d660e4a7571813fb43839c79e3e9ca7720` (included in stable main). ZIP SHA-256: `ffedc53390c9da6e859f41e432c5d2d0615a23cf00a503181f07efbba88a7ce8`.

name: Archify DSH 1.0.0
body:
# Archify DSH 1.0.0

`@tt-a1i/archify-dsh@1.0.0` brings the Archify 3.x authoring and delivery flow to the DeepSeek Harness community integration. It bundles Archify **3.0.1**, including the post-tag Skill installation fix from #704, from immutable source `7158026e852f3aa6578c741e673b46d7878c92c1`. Adapter and Archify version numbers are independent.

The supported host is exactly **`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.2-rc.1`**, with Node **`^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`**. DSH remains a developer preview; the adapter's 1.0 contract does not promise compatibility with other host versions. This is a community integration, not an official DeepSeek product.

## Install and upgrade

Update the DSH host separately to the supported version, then run this command in each profile that uses Archify:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @tt-a1i/archify-dsh@1.0.0
```

The same command upgrades the previous plugin. Archify 3.x includes authored brand marks, Workflow schema v2, Viewer localization, and optional update awareness. Existing schema-v1 inputs remain supported; existing HTML retains its embedded Viewer. See the [Archify 3.0 upgrade notes](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify/blob/v3.0.1/CHANGELOG.md#upgrading-from-2x).

This release preserves the single `archify-plugin` filesystem Skill provider. It adds no native tools, runtime dependencies, lifecycle scripts, telemetry, credentials handling, or automatic plugin upgrades. The host evaluates the package's bounded `cordis.patch.yml` resolution expression outside the agent sandbox. Generated files remain ordinary workspace files, without automatic Web Produced Files chips.

The prepared adapter 0.2.0 was never published. Published 0.1.0 remains immutable; 1.0.0 supersedes that candidate.

## Release validation

The release gate covers clean installation and integrity-pinned published plugin 0.1.0 → 1.0.0 upgrade in isolated profiles on Linux, macOS, and Windows. It checks installed bytes, single-provider discovery and Skill loading, installed CLI `doctor` and `demo`, uninstall, and preservation of the base profile. The full source-version smoke runs on a temporary copy to preserve pnpm store hard links.

name: v3.0.1
body:
Archify 3.0.1 makes stable update reminders part of normal diagram delivery. `finalize` and standalone `deliver` now include a bounded update result in their receipts and terminal output, and the Skill carries one reminder into its final response when a newer verified release is known. A reminder repeats until the user updates or explicitly asks to snooze it for seven days or ignore that exact release. Checks use the fixed official manifest and cached results; no update installs automatically.

The diagram format, generated HTML/SVG content, validation quality gates, and existing path protections are unchanged. See the [changelog](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify/blob/v3.0.1/CHANGELOG.md) for the full entry.

## What's Changed
* Publish v3.0.0 stable update manifest by @tt-a1i in https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify/pull/598
* Keep update notices in diagram delivery receipts by @tt-a1i in https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify/pull/599
* Promote update reminders to stable by @tt-a1i in https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify/pull/610
* Release Archify v3.0.1 by @tt-a1i in https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify/pull/611


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify/compare/v3.0.0...v3.0.1

name: Archify 3.0 — Clearer diagrams, verified delivery
body:
# Archify 3.0 — Clearer diagrams, verified delivery

Archify 3.0 brings a redesigned diagram reader, clearer layout and routing, and a delivery workflow that verifies the generated artifact before handing it back. It follows the integrated changes and real-project trials on `dev`.

## What changed

- **A redesigned reader.** Notes sit below the diagram by default. The reader fits the diagram and controls to the first screen where its readability floors allow, with zoom for detail and scrolling when necessary. Narrow diagrams also retain a usable page layout.
- **Clearer diagrams.** Architecture and Workflow placement and routing handle fan-out, return paths, labels and shared corridors more carefully. Lifecycle v2 introduces lane/column layout, state marks and better source-badge spacing while retaining schema-v1 geometry support.
- **Sequence diagrams that use their canvas.** Legends sit below all timeline content, can wrap into multiple rows, and no longer intersect lifelines. Message labels follow their line colors. Measured width advice guides one bounded spread repair for new unpinned diagrams, including participants with brand logos.
- **Verified delivery across all five types.** Repository-backed sources, artifact provenance, composition checks and browser checks participate in the delivery workflow. Windows path handling, reproducible packages and cross-platform smoke checks have been hardened.
- **Viewer translations supplied as data.** English and Simplified Chinese remain built in; `meta.translations` supplies other Viewer languages without adding renderer-specific locale branches.

## Upgrading from 2.x

- Guided/story views and ordinary share-card exports have been removed. Use the overview, Route, Lens and canonical exports. Existing `meta.views` data is accepted but ignored; already-generated standalone HTML retains its embedded viewer.
- Existing schema-v1 inputs remain supported. Use Lifecycle v2 for new diagrams when its grid layout fits the task; converting existing v1 files is not required.
- Viewer translations and authored diagram text are separate: translating the Viewer does not translate node names or message labels.
- The Skill still runs on Node.js 18 or newer. The canonical ZIP is built with the pinned Node 22 toolchain; users do not need that packaging toolchain to run it.

## Validation and remaining limits

The integrated batch passed full Node-version, browser/WebM, Windows path, cross-platform package and DSH checks. Real-project trials also informed the legend, first-screen and Sequence-width fixes. Automated checks are not a guarantee of perfect composition: complex branching workflows may still need authoring repairs, some layouts retain crossings, and software-oriented legends may need adjustment for non-software subjects.

Use the attached `archify.zip` for the canonical Skill package. See the [3.0.0 changelog](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify/blob/v3.0.0/CHANGELOG.md#300--2026-09-28) for the detailed changes and contributor attribution.

## 中文摘要

Archify 3.0 更新了图形查看器、布局与路由、Lifecycle v2，以及生成后的交付检查。时序图的图例会避开消息和生命线，宽画布留白也会给出有次数限制的修复建议。

升级时请注意：引导视图和普通分享卡导出已移除；旧的 `meta.views` 数据仍可读取，但不再展示。已有 v1 图形输入继续支持，已经生成的独立 HTML 不会被升级自动改写。复杂流程仍可能需要调整，自动检查通过不等于每张图都无需视觉审查。

---

name: Archify for DeepSeek Harness v0.1.0
body:
First experimental community release of the opt-in Archify Skill-only bundle for DeepSeek Harness.

Install: dsh plugin --profile web add @tt-a1i/archify-dsh@0.1.0

Compatibility:
- @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6
- Node.js ^22.19.0 or >=24.0.0
- Ubuntu, macOS, and Windows release matrix passed

Isolation:
- no changes to the default non-DSH Archify path
- no telemetry, network client, credentials handling, background service, or lifecycle install hooks
- community integration, not an official DeepSeek product

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tt-a1i/archify-dsh
Details: https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify/tree/main/integrations/deepseek-harness

name: v2.3.1 — Doc sync + menu polish + canvas guard
body:
Audit-driven patch. Three Opus reviewers found a handful of stale statements and rough edges after the 2.0 -> 2.3 release sequence; this ships the fixes in one cohesive pass.

## Fixed

- **Stale docs.** \`SKILL.md\` frontmatter and two "2x retina" bullets updated to the current 4× pipeline. \`README.md\` cleaned in four places (intro paragraph, "What's new" table — now includes a v2.2 column —, Export menu description, and technical-details section).
- **Canvas-size clamp.** \`rasterize()\` now picks the largest integer scale in \`{4,3,2,1}\` whose target canvas fits under 16 Mpx. Default diagrams stay at 4×; very large viewBoxes (~1600×1200+) step down automatically instead of producing blank canvases on older iOS Safari.
- **\`?openExport=1\` font race.** \`setTimeout(open, 60)\` replaced with \`document.fonts.ready.then(open)\` + double \`requestAnimationFrame\`. No more flash on slow connections.

## Added

- **Export menu separators.** Two \`<hr role="separator">\` dividers split the menu into *Copy / Raster / Vector*. "Copy PNG" / "Download PNG" are no longer visually adjacent.
- **"Copy PNG" renamed to "Copy to clipboard"** (PNG moved to hint badge). Destination is now in the primary label.
- **Print CSS polish.** \`@page { size: landscape; margin: 1.5cm; }\`, summary cards become a 2-column grid in print (no orphans), container width lifted, \`page-break-inside: avoid\` added alongside \`break-inside: avoid\`.

## Install

Claude.ai: **Settings → Capabilities → Skills → + Add → upload \`archify.zip\`**.

Claude Code CLI:
\`\`\`bash
rm -rf ~/.claude/skills/archify
unzip archify.zip -d ~/.claude/skills/
\`\`\`

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md#231--2026-04-15) for line-by-line detail.

name: v2.3.0 — Sharp 4× raster exports
body:
Quality release. Fixes the reason raster exports looked soft, and removes the scale selector that was tempting users into soft output.

## What was wrong

The export pipeline used to rasterize the SVG at its natural \`viewBox\` size (e.g., 1000×680), then \`ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width * scale, height * scale)\` bitmap-upsampled that small raster onto a larger canvas. That just blew up pixels — the image got bigger, but no sharper. Even at 4× the output looked soft.

## What changed

\`serializeSvg()\` now sets the serialized SVG's \`width\` / \`height\` to \`4 × viewBox\` (the viewBox itself is untouched, so coordinates don't shift). The browser rasterizes the vectors natively at that target resolution. \`drawImage\` then draws at the image's natural size with no scaling. Result: edges, text, arrowheads, dashed strokes are all genuinely crisp at 4×.

The 1× / 2× / 4× selector is gone — every raster export is now 4× by default. A typical diagram exports at 4000×2720 (≈300-700 KB PNG). That's the sharpest you can get from the source, which is what you actually want when pasting into a slide deck or docs.

## Also

- JPEG / WebP quality bumped 0.92 → 0.95 (tiny file delta, cleaner edges)
- Toast no longer echoes the scale (always 4× now)
- Menu keyboard nav simplified; all other shortcuts preserved
- Preview screenshots and \`examples/web-app.html\` regenerated

## Install

Claude.ai: **Settings → Capabilities → Skills → + Add → upload \`archify.zip\`**.

Claude Code CLI:
\`\`\`bash
rm -rf ~/.claude/skills/archify
unzip archify.zip -d ~/.claude/skills/
\`\`\`

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md#230--2026-04-15) for details.

name: v2.2.1 — Security group label padding fix
body:
Patch release. Fixes a visual bug where the \`sg-name :port\` label on the dashed security-group boundary sat ~1px above the component inside it, crowding the box below.

## Fix

- Expanded the template's security-group example from \`y=265 h=80\` to \`y=250 h=100\` and moved the label baseline from \`y=279\` to \`y=268\`, yielding a clean ~12px gap between the label and the inner component.

## Docs

\`SKILL.md\` now has a dedicated **Security Group & Region Boundary Padding** section with the offset rule (boundary \`y = inner.y - 30\`, \`h = inner.h + 50\`, label 18px below boundary top) and a concrete example — so future Claude-generated diagrams inherit the spacing automatically.

## Install

Claude.ai: **Settings → Capabilities → Skills → + Add → upload \`archify.zip\`**.

Claude Code CLI:
\`\`\`bash
rm -rf ~/.claude/skills/archify
unzip archify.zip -d ~/.claude/skills/
\`\`\`

name: v2.2.0 — Print stylesheet + local-font fallback
body:
Polish release. Two small but delightful quality-of-life improvements.

## Highlights

- **Print stylesheet.** Cmd+P now produces a clean printable page: toolbar and toasts hidden, dark background replaced with white, grid dropped, panel/card borders switched to light gray. \`break-inside: avoid\` keeps the diagram and summary cards intact across page boundaries. Works regardless of current theme.
- **Better font fallback in exported images.** The serialized SVG now carries a \`local()\`-only \`@font-face\` rule for JetBrains Mono so that raster exports can pick up a locally-installed JetBrains Mono and cleanly fall through to \`ui-monospace\` / Menlo otherwise.

## Preview

Print-mode rendering of a diagram — toolbar and grid gone, background white, card borders soft gray:

![Print preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tt-a1i/archify/main/examples/images/archify-print.png)

## Install

Claude.ai: **Settings → Capabilities → Skills → + Add → upload \`archify.zip\`**.

Claude Code CLI:
\`\`\`bash
rm -rf ~/.claude/skills/archify
unzip archify.zip -d ~/.claude/skills/
\`\`\`

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md#220--2026-04-15) for the full entry.

name: v2.1.0 — Copy to clipboard + 1×/2×/4× export scale
body:
Second release. Builds on [v2.0.0](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify/releases/tag/v2.0.0) (theme toggle + multi-format export) with two high-frequency workflow upgrades.

## Highlights

- **Copy PNG to clipboard** — one click writes the diagram straight to your system clipboard via \`ClipboardItem\`. Paste into Slack, Notion, GitHub, Figma, Keynote, anywhere. No download + drag dance.
- **Export scale selector (1× / 2× / 4×)** at the top of the Export menu. 1× for chat embeds, 2× retina default, 4× for conference slides and print. Selection persists per browser. Keyboard: \`←\` / \`→\` on the selector to switch.
- **Toast feedback** after copy so you know it landed.
- **URL param \`?openExport=1\`** auto-opens the menu on load — useful for screenshots and embedded demos.

## Install

Claude.ai: **Settings → Capabilities → Skills → + Add → upload \`archify.zip\`**.

Claude Code CLI:
\`\`\`bash
# If you have v2.0 already installed, replace it
rm -rf ~/.claude/skills/archify
unzip archify.zip -d ~/.claude/skills/
\`\`\`

## Preview

The new Export menu with scale selector and Copy PNG:

![Export menu](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tt-a1i/archify/main/examples/images/archify-menu.png)

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md#210--2026-04-15) for the full list.

name: v2.0.0 — Theme toggle + multi-format export
body:
First Archify release. Fork / rewrite of [`Cocoon-AI/architecture-diagram-generator`](https://github.com/Cocoon-AI/architecture-diagram-generator) v1.0 (MIT).

## Highlights

- **Dark / Light theme toggle** — one click, persists in `localStorage`, respects `prefers-color-scheme`, overridable per-page via `?theme=` URL parameter.
- **One-click export** — PNG, JPEG, WebP (2× retina) and SVG (vector). Works entirely in the browser, no server.
- **Keyboard shortcuts** — \`T\` toggles theme, \`E\` opens Export. Menu supports Arrow / Home / End / Esc / Tab.
- **CSS-variable theme system** — one SVG markup, two themes.
- **Accessibility** — full ARIA semantics, keyboard navigation, focus-visible outlines.

## Install

Claude.ai: **Settings → Capabilities → Skills → + Add → upload \`archify.zip\`**.

Claude Code CLI:
\`\`\`bash
unzip archify.zip -d ~/.claude/skills/
\`\`\`

## Preview

![Dark theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tt-a1i/archify/main/examples/images/archify-dark.png)
![Light theme](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tt-a1i/archify/main/examples/images/archify-light.png)

See [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for the full list of additions and fixes.
